mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Hare Apparent: "When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 white Rabbit creature
# tokens equal to the number of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent. A deck can have
# any number of cards named Hare Apparent."
# Enters: CREATE_TOKEN of a 1/1 white Rabbit (M20 Raise the Alarm's token shape) whose count is
# M21 Rin and Seri's verified "the number of Cats you control" QCount (ALL over the battlefield)
# with M21 Frantic Inventory's verified NAME_EQ for "named Hare Apparent", your creatures other
# than this one (FNot(IS_SOURCE), "other"). The count is read as the trigger resolves.
# The deck rule has no tree: the label "deck rule" (MAPPER_GUIDE, Labelled sentences).
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
        'count': QCount(
            selector=Selector(
                count=QUnbounded(),
                mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                filter=FAnd(
                    children=(
                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.NAME_EQ, string_value='Hare Apparent'),
                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                        FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                    ),
                ),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
        ),
        'tokens': TokenSpec(
            name='Rabbit',
            type_line='Creature — Rabbit',
            types=('Creature',),
            subtypes=('Rabbit',),
            power=QConst(value=1),
            toughness=QConst(value=1),
            keywords=(),
            abilities=(),
            colors=('W',),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]

mapping.notes: CREATE_TOKEN of a 1/1 white Rabbit; the count is Rin and Seri's verified QCount of your creatures with Frantic Inventory's NAME_EQ 'Hare Apparent' and FNot(IS_SOURCE) ('other'), read on resolution. The deck rule takes the label 'deck rule' (MAPPER_GUIDE, Labelled sentences). Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/hare_apparent_a_rabbit_for_each_other_hare_you_control.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/hare_apparent_the_first_hare_makes_no_rabbit.json.

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 white Rabbit creature tokens equal to the number of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.
clauses.evidence: Tree: ZoneChangeEvent(IS_SOURCE) -> CREATE_TOKEN count QCount(ALL Selector FAnd(CONTROLLER_IS YOU, NAME_EQ 'Hare Apparent', Creature, FNot(IS_SOURCE))), TokenSpec Rabbit, Creature — Rabbit, 1/1, colours ('W',). The probe board holds no other Hare Apparent, so every variant counts 0 and no token is ever created: the count, the token and the trigger's effect are never seen. Packs: H05_1 (one other: one Rabbit, 1/1, no keywords), H05_2 (two others: two), H05_3 (the opponent's Hare and other creatures do not count), H05_4 (counted as the trigger resolves), H05_5 (control, not ownership).

clauses.clause: A deck can have any number of cards named Hare Apparent.
clauses.evidence: Deck-construction rule (CR 100.2a), the guide's own 'deck rule' label case (MAPPER_GUIDE 'Labelled sentences' names FDN Hare Apparent). It means nothing in a game, no tree node implements it, and the tree adds nothing for it, as it should. The deck builders read it off the printed sentence: games.deck_rule_copies('A deck can have any number of cards named Hare Apparent.', 'Hare Apparent') returns 60 (DECK_SIZE). The packet carries no clause map, so the record's label itself is not visible to me.
